name: lumen-analytics-mcp-server
description: Read-only MCP server over the Lumen Analytics demo: metric search, recent anomalies, and per-slice cause attribution.
comment: Not a standalone package: dependencies (@modelcontextprotocol/sdk, zod, better-sqlite3) resolve from the repository root node_modules. Build and run via the root package.json scripts (mcp:build, mcp:start, mcp:dev).
